{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Seymour Saul Lipschutz''' (born 1931 died March 2018) was an author of technical books on [[pure mathematics]] and [[probability]], including a collection of [[Schaum's Outlines]].<ref name=cs_retirees/>

Lipschutz received his Ph.D. in 1960 from [[New York University]]'s [[Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences|Courant Institute]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=33858|name=Seymour Saul Lipschutz}}</ref>  He received his BA and MA degrees in Mathematics at [[Brooklyn College]]. He was a mathematics professor at [[Temple University]], and before that on the faculty at the [[Polytechnic Institute of Brooklyn]].<ref name=cs_retirees>{{cite web |url=http://cstretirees.wordpress.com/seymour-lipschutz/ |title=Seymour Lipschutz |accessdate=2014-11-03 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20141224130322/https://cstretirees.wordpress.com/seymour-lipschutz/ |archivedate=2014-12-24 }}</ref>
